prompt:
Use case: product-mockup.
Asset type: square photorealistic luxury catalog image for Japanese satirical shop 伊見内商会.
Primary request: photograph an elegant physical certificate granting "the right to do nothing". Replace the concept of a lounge chair with a beautiful certificate as the sole product.
Scene: dark navy charcoal studio, low black velvet display plinth, understated warm jewelry-store spotlight, realistic contact shadows.
Subject: one upright ivory cotton-paper certificate, fully visible and centered within central 75% of square frame, nearly front-on with subtle perspective. Fine restrained gold double border, small tasteful botanical ornament, embossed gold foil medallion at bottom. Real paper grain and realistic gold foil, refined Japanese serif typography.
Text (verbatim, accurately readable Japanese): top small "伊見内商会"; large centered title "何もしない権利書"; below in small text "何もしないことを、ここに認めます。"; footer small "法的効力はありません".
Composition: certificate fills most of image, ample dark background around all edges, no cropping. Premium museum still-life product photography matching a dark navy luxury storefront. No people, chair, hands, extra objects, watermark, real institutional seals, glow, glitter or exaggerated ornament.
